text: Can import your memory when switching from another AI provider to continue where you left off
quote: Switching to Claude from another AI provider? Import your memory and pick up where you left off.

text: Can search through your previous conversations to find and reuse relevant information in new chats
quote: You can prompt Claude to search through your previous conversations to find and reference relevant information in new chats.

text: Supports full real-time spoken conversations via Voice mode
quote: Voice mode allows you to have complete spoken conversations with Claude.

text: Cowork lets you describe a desired outcome, step away, and return to completed formatted documents, organized files, or research
quote: With Cowork, you can describe an outcome, step away, and come back to finished work—formatted documents, organized files, synthesized research, and more.

text: Can delegate recurring scheduled tasks that automatically produce reports, briefings, and summaries
quote: Scheduled tasks allow you to delegate work to Claude Cowork by creating tasks that run automatically on a recurring basis, or on demand.

text: Can autonomously operate a web browser—opening sites, clicking, typing, and filling forms while you watch
quote: Claude opens sites, reads pages, clicks, types, and fills forms while you watch, with no need to switch windows.

text: Computer-use mode lets Claude directly click, type, and open apps on your screen like a human would
quote: it may navigate to your screen directly—clicking, typing, and opening apps just like you would.

text: Claude Code CLI lets you build in the terminal, deploy to a URL, and test/verify via a Chrome browser extension
quote: Build with Claude Code in your terminal, then deploy to a URL Claude can reach. Test and verify in the browser with the Chrome extension. Debug issues using console logs

text: Can debug web apps by reading console logs, network requests, and DOM state directly in the browser
quote: Debug issues using console logs—Claude can read errors, network requests, and DOM state directly.

text: Claude Desktop can be installed via Anthropic's apt repository so updates arrive through normal system package updates
quote: you can install Claude Desktop from Anthropic's apt repository rather than as a downloaded .deb file so that updates arrive through your system's normal package updates

text: Official iOS app available on the App Store
quote: You can install the Claude app onto your iOS device by navigating to the App Store and searching for “Claude by Anthropic”

text: Audit logs capture user actions, system events, and data access for compliance
quote: Audit logs: capture key information about user actions, system events, and data access. ... Compliance API: programmatically access Claude usage data including activity logs, chat histories, and file content

text: Compliance API allows programmatic access to usage data, chat histories, and file content
quote: Audit logs: capture key information about user actions, system events, and data access. ... Compliance API: programmatically access Claude usage data including activity logs, chat histories, and file content

text: Individual users can export their account information and chat history from Settings
quote: Individual Claude users can export user information and chat history from Settings > Privacy

text: Artifacts support multiple content types including documents, code snippets, diagrams, and interactive React components
quote: Common examples of artifact content include: - Documents (Markdown or plain text) - Code snippets - Single-page HTML websites - SVG images - Diagrams and flowcharts - Interactive React components

text: Can read and analyze many document formats including PDF, DOCX, CSV, TXT, HTML, ODT, RTF, EPUB, JSON, and XLSX
quote: Claude can work with the following document types: - PDF - DOCX - CSV - TXT - HTML - ODT - RTF - EPUB - JSON - XLSX

text: Can generate downloadable Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and PDF files from natural-language prompts
quote: Prompt Claude using natural language to generate Excel spreadsheets, PowerPoint presentations, Word documents, and PDF files that you can download and use immediately.

text: Projects provide self-contained workspaces with their own chat histories and knowledge bases
quote: Projects allow you to create self-contained workspaces with their own chat histories and knowledge bases.

text: A unified directory lets users find and install skills, connectors, and plugins that customize Claude
quote: Our unified directory brings skills, connectors, and plugins together in one place so you can find and install everything that customizes Claude

text: Can connect to existing remote MCP servers or build your own to integrate any tool
quote: You can: Connect Claude to existing remote MCP servers. Build your own remote MCP servers to connect with any tool.

text: Can connect Gmail, Google Calendar, and Google Drive to search, send email, manage calendar, and work with files inside chat
quote: Connect your Gmail, Google Calendar, and Google Drive to Claude so you can search and send emails, manage your calendar, work with documents, and save files—all without leaving the conversation.

text: Research mode delivers thorough, cited answers by autonomously running multiple linked searches
quote: Research transforms how Claude finds and analyzes information. Claude operates agentically, conducting multiple searches that build on each other while determining exactly what to investigate next.

text: Desktop apps bring Claude's capabilities directly to your computer for seamless workflow integration
quote: The Claude desktop apps bring Claude's capabilities directly to your computer, allowing for seamless integration with your workflow.

text: Can take on complex, multi-step tasks and execute them autonomously on the user's behalf
quote: Claude can take on complex, multi-step tasks and execute them on your behalf.

text: Artifacts let you turn ideas into shareable apps, tools, and visualizations just by describing them
quote: Artifacts allow you to turn ideas into shareable apps, tools, or content—build tools, visualizations, and experiences by simply describing what you need.

text: Can generate code and produce data visualizations
quote: Generate code and visualize data

text: Gmail, Drive, and Calendar connector data is not used to train Claude's models
quote: We do not train our models on your Gmail, Drive, or Calendar connector data, ensuring your private information remains private.

text: Users can review, edit, and turn on/off what Claude remembers via chat search and memory settings
quote: This article explains how chat search and memory work, what Claude does and doesn’t remember, how to review and edit what’s saved, and how to turn these features on or off.

text: Incognito chats are excluded from model improvement even if Model Improvement is enabled elsewhere
quote: Your incognito chats are not used to improve Claude, even if you have enabled Model Improvement in your privacy settings.

text: Multiple layers of privacy protection are applied when chats or coding sessions are used to improve Claude
quote: When you allow us to use your chats or coding sessions to help improve Claude, we implement several layers of protection for your privacy.

text: Data exports include full conversation data and account user data
quote: Data exports include conversation data and the user data for your account.
